description: Validate a list of goods-and-services terms against the EUIPO's harmonised database (TMClass) — checks whether each term is a recognised ("harmonized") term, and flags invalid characters, duplicates, forbidden terms, and length problems. Use before filing to catch terms an examiner would object to. Returns per-term accepted/not-accepted status plus raw. Example: euipo_validate_goods_services({ terms: ["computer software", "C@ts and dog$"], nice_class: 9, language: "en", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

language.description: Language the terms are written in, e.g. "en". Required by the upstream API; defaults to "en".

nice_class.description: Nice classification class the terms belong to, e.g. 9. The upstream validates terms per class.

terms.description: Goods-and-services terms to validate, e.g. ["computer software", "downloadable mobile applications"].

name: euipo_validate_goods_services
title: Euipo Validate Goods Services
